{"code":"function resolve_attack(attacker, defender, skill)
    -- helper: floor and clamp
    local p = max(10, math.floor(math.floor(math.pow(attacker.attk, attacker.crit_chance/100)*attrk_mult/100)*attrk_mult))
    local d = math.floor(attacker.attk * p / 100)
    local level_diff = math.clamp(attacker.level - defender.level, -10, 10)
    local crit Chance = (skill.seed + 17*1) % 100
    local crit Chance = math.floor(crit Chance * skill.crit_mult / 100)
    -- critical condition
    local crit Chance = math.floor(crit Chance * skill.crit_mult / 100)
    local crit Chance = math.floor(crit Chance * skill.crit_mult / 100)
    -- apply armor, element, guard, etc.
    local pen = skill.pen_pct
    local ea = math.floor(defender.armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - skill.pen_flat
    local d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
    -- element multiplier
    local m = math.floor(math.floor(math.pow(attacker.element, defender.element) / 100))
    local d = math.floor(d * m / 100)
    -- resistance
    local resist = skill.resist[skill.element]
    local r = math.clamp(defender.resist[skill.element], -50, 80)
    local d = math.floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
    -- guard if guarding
    local guard = defender.guarding
    if guard then d = d / 2 end
    -- minimum
    local d = math.clamp(d, 1, d)
    -- shield and HP
    local a = math.min(defender.shield, d)
    local loss = d - a
    local shatter = a > 0 and math.floor(loss * 125 / 100)
    -- HP
    local overkill = math.max(0, loss - defender.hp)
    -- results
    local damage = defender.hp - (defender.hp + shatter + overkill)
    local absorbed = a + shatter
    local hp = defender.hp - loss
    local shield = defender.shield - a
    local overkill = 0
    local crits = crit Chance
    local hits = 1
    local killed = crit Chance > 0
    return {damage, absorbed, hp, shield, overkill, crits, hits, killed}
end"}

  [2][1] = ".", [2][2] = ".", [2][3] = ".",
  [3][1] = ".", [3][2] = ".", [3][3] = ".",
  [4][1] = ".", [4][2] = ".", [4][3] = ".",
  [5][1] = ".", [5][2] = ".", [5][3] = ".",
  [6][1] = ".", [6][2] = ".", [6][3] = "."
}
cost = {}
teleporters = {}

function dijkstra_direct(grid)
  local rows = grid:shape()
  local start = (1,1)
  goal = (1,3)
  cost_start = 0
  actions_start = 0
  
  dist = {}
  dist[start] = {cost=start, actions=start}
  
  for r in range(1, rows[1]) do
    for c in range(1, grid:shape()[2]) do
      if grid[r][c] == "." then
        cost[r][c] = 1
        actions[r][c] = 0
      elseif grid[r][c] == "S" then
        cost[r][c] = cost_start + 1
        actions[r][c] = 1
        cost_start = cost_start + 1
      elseif grid[r][c] == "G" then
        cost[r][c] = cost_start + 1
        actions[r][c] = 1
        cost_start = cost_start + 1
      elseif grid[r][c] == "~" then
        cost[r][c] = cost_start + 3
        actions[r][c] = 1
        cost_start = cost_start + 3
      elseif grid[r][c] == "#" then
        cost[r][c] = math.hmax(cost[r][c], cost_start + 1)
        actions[r][c] = math.hmax(actions[r][c], cost_start + 1)
        continue
      elseif grid[r][c] == "A" or grid[r][c] == "B" then
        cost[r][c] = cost_start + 0
        actions[r][c] = 1
        cost_start = cost_start + 0
      elseif grid[r][c] == ">" then
        cost[r][c] = cost_start + 0
        actions[r][c] = 1
        cost_start = cost_start + 0
      elseif grid[r][c] == "<" or grid[r][c] == "^" or grid[r][c] == "v" then
        cost[r][c] = cost_start + 0
        actions[r][c] = 1
        cost_start = cost_start + 0
      end
    end
  end
  
  if dist[goal].cost == math.hmax(dist[start].cost, cost_start) then
    return {cost=dist[goal].cost, actions=dist[goal].actions}
  else
    return {-1, -1}
  end
end

-- Compute for grid with teleporters (empty)
local result = dijkstra_direct(grid)
print(result)
end"}
